note: Scoped idle-path trials after restoring baseline scheduling. Seven-run exploratory comparisons, same firmware and instruction contract; aggregate load does not exclude brief contention. Only final scope-cpu.json determines acceptance.

trials.measurement: resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) user + system CPU seconds around one completed CLI subprocess; seven samples per arm after one excluded warmup; reverse order in even rounds
limitations: Local macOS arm64 CPU-time comparison, not browser or hardware timing.
No process inventory retained; every subprocess starts only below one-minute load 3.
All arms use unchanged native scheduling and identical firmware, instructions, cycles and console hash.
